description.value:
Magic dances between the two weapons you wield. Fighting groups of enemies takes full advantage of your capabilities as you move from one foe to another.

While in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Arcane Cascade] stance, if you make a Strike with a melee weapon you're holding, you can intensify the stance's power for another melee weapon of your choice you're holding in a different hand. Until the end of your turn, any extra damage the chosen weapon gains from Arcane Cascade is increased to 2. The extra damage increases to 4 if you have weapon specialization or 6 if you have greater weapon specialization.
